setting: school sports day on the mountain-view field; athletic gym uniforms, hats where appropriate, no formal school jackets during competition

sentences.english: On the morning of the sports day, the schoolyard was full of children's cheerful voices.
sentences.japanese: 運動会の朝、校庭は子どもたちの元気な声でいっぱいでした。

sentences.english: For each grade, there were many races and matches.
sentences.japanese: 学年ごとに、いろんな徒競走や試合がありました。

sentences.english: In the class race, I ran with all my energy.
sentences.japanese: クラス対抗の徒競走で、わたしは精いっぱい走りました。

sentences.english: On the last straight, I could see two runners in front of me.
sentences.japanese: 最後の直線では、前に2人の姿が見えます。

sentences.english: “I will not give up,” I said to myself, and ran toward the goal.
sentences.japanese: 「まだあきらめない」と心の中でつぶやいて、ゴールテープを目指しました。

sentences.english: At the next event, my brother threw a ball high, and his friend caught it firmly.
sentences.japanese: 兄がボールを投げ、わたしはそれをしっかり受け止めました。
「ナイスキャッチ！」と兄が叫びました。

sentences.english: a big cheer rose into the blue sky.
sentences.japanese: みんなの歓声が空に広がりました。

sentences.english: From far away, I could hear the sound of a soccer ball being hit strongly.
sentences.japanese: 遠くからは、サッカーボールを強く蹴る音も聞こえてきました。

sentences.english: The boys were chasing the ball happily, and even when they fell, they stood up right away.
sentences.japanese: 男の子たちは楽しそうにボールを追いかけて、転んでもすぐに立ち上がっていました。

sentences.english: Having fun is the most important thing,” our teacher said kindly.
sentences.japanese: 楽しむことが一番大事だからね」と先生はやさしく言ってくれました。

sentences.english: My sister became the first in the race and wore a big gold medal on her chest.
sentences.japanese: 妹は徒競走で一位になって、胸に大きな金メダルをかけてもらいました。

sentences.english: As a first time winner, she looked proud all day.
sentences.japanese: 初めての一位として、一日中ほこらしそうな顔をしていました。
